content.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder begin their playoff run Sunday against the Phoenix Suns in Game 1 of a West first-round series featuring the top seed versus a battle-tested play-in survivor. Oklahoma City enters as the No. 1 seed after a 64–18 regular season, the best record in the NBA, while Phoenix secured the No. 8 seed by defeating Golden State in the play-in to clinch this matchup. The Thunder also held a 3–2 edge in the regular-season series, reinforcing their status as favorites heading into the opener. Phoenix, meanwhile, enters with momentum after its play-in win, powered by Devin Booker (26.1 PPG) and a roster capable of explosive scoring stretches.
